code: body { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 20, 60, 0.6), 0 0 20px rgba(255, 20, 60, 0.3); animation: tensionPulse 3s infinite alternate ease-in-out; } @keyframes tensionPulse { 0% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(255,0,50,0.5)); } 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,0,50,0.8)) hue-rotate(5deg); } }

body { background: #030000 !important; color: #110000 !important; transition: all 2s ease-in-out; } .chat-container { background: transparent !important; border: none !important; box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.05) !important; } .message.ai { color: #cc0000 !important; text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.8) !important; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 1px; } .message.user { opacity: 0.1 !important; } @keyframes dyingPulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px #220000; } 50% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px #660000; } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px #220000; } } #app { animation: dyingPulse 3s infinite !important; }

body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; box-shadow: inset 0 0 300px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.9); pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; animation: pulseCrisis 0.4s infinite alternate; } @keyframes pulseCrisis { from { opacity: 0.6; } to { opacity: 1; } } body, .chat-container, .message { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.8); color: #ffe6e6; transition: all 0.2s ease; }

body { background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1a001a 0%, #000000 100%); } #app-container { box-shadow: 0 0 30px #ff0055, 0 0 60px #8800ff; animation: plasmaPulse 2s infinite alternate; transition: all 0.5s ease-in-out; } @keyframes plasmaPulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px #ff0055, 0 0 60px #8800ff; border-color: #ff0055; } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 50px #ff0055, 0 0 120px #ff00aa; border-color: #ff00aa; } } .message.ai { text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.5); }
